title: Skill evaluation grade
$comment: Grading model: `score` (0..100) is authoritative. `overall_pass` is derived (score >= pass threshold, default 70) and kept for compatibility. `verdict` is a display-only band (pass/partial/fail) also derivable from score; it is NOT cross-checked against overall_pass. `insufficient_evidence` is the one non-derivable signal: it means the judge could not evaluate and routes the trial to needs_review.

verdict.$comment: Display-only band / abstention signal. Optional (nullable). Not cross-checked against overall_pass.
